::: {#def-embedding}

#### Embedding

An **embedding** layer maps each of $K$ symbols,
such as characters or words,
to a vector in $\reals^d$.
Symbol $k$ maps to row $k$ of a $K \times d$ matrix $\matr{E}$ of [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter),
learned with the rest of the network
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 12.4.2].
Row $k$ is the **embedding** of symbol $k$,
also called its **embedding vector**.
The layer equals a linear layer with no bias applied to the [one-hot encoding](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-one-hot-encoding) of the symbol,
computed by looking up the row.

:::
